name: Python + Litestar + SQLAlchemy 2 + PostgreSQL + Redis
note: Each task runs a real command. Token figures are not recorded here; evals/runner.py measures context cost directly. The starter keeps items in an in-memory store, so no PostgreSQL or Redis is needed. SEC-09 (asyncpg pool) and SEC-11 (Redis) have no code in the starter and are not asserted by tests.

eval_tasks.title: Litestar app boots and serves the health probe
eval_tasks.instruction: The app must import and answer GET /health.
eval_tasks.verify: cd starter && python -m pytest tests/test_app.py -k health -q -p no:warnings

eval_tasks.title: Typed item API round-trips
eval_tasks.instruction: Create and list items through the pydantic schemas.
eval_tasks.verify: cd starter && python -m pytest tests/test_app.py -q -p no:warnings

eval_tasks.title: Declared security controls hold under test
eval_tasks.instruction: Run the suite covering SEC-03..08 and SEC-10: tenant isolation, unknown-field rejection, CORS, rootless container, health, error disclosure.
assertions: a foreign tenant gets 404, identical to a missing id
unknown fields and oversize values are rejected
CORS has no wildcard and does not reflect an unlisted origin
debug is off and 500s do not leak internals
eval_tasks.verify: cd starter && python -m pytest tests/test_security.py -q -p no:warnings

eval_tasks.title: Full suite green
eval_tasks.instruction: The complete functional and security suite passes.
eval_tasks.verify: cd starter && python -m pytest tests/ -q -p no:warnings
